props.name: actionWidth
props.description: Width of the revealed trailing action panel in px.

props.name: commitThreshold
props.description:
Fraction of `rowWidth` the user must drag past to fire `commit` instead
of just snapping open. Range 0–1.

props.name: commitVelocity
props.description:
Absolute velocity in px/s (leftward) above which a flick fires `commit`
regardless of position.

props.name: rowWidth
props.description: Width of the row in px. Required to compute the commit threshold.

props.name: snapThreshold
props.description:
Fraction of `actionWidth` the user must drag past (without velocity) to
snap open. Range 0–1.

props.name: velocityThreshold
props.description: Absolute velocity in px/s for "snap to open" / "snap to closed" override.
